Specification: This module defines a bounded model-checking wrapper for a multi-node reads specification. It extends two other modules and adds a combined next-state action that allows either the underlying multi-node transition or read-only transaction request/response actions, then defines a standard safety-style temporal specification using Init and a boxed next-step formula. The file itself contains no local state declarations, constants, fairness, proofs, or PlusCal algorithm; it serves as a small composition layer over actions defined elsewhere.
